name: io.github.newrelic-experimental/preflight
description: New Relic MCP server for observing AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, etc.)

packageArguments.name: --stdio
packageArguments.description: Run as an MCP stdio server (required for MCP clients)

environmentVariables.name: NEW_RELIC_LICENSE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: New Relic ingest license key. Optional: while NR_AI_MODE is unset or local, Preflight runs local-only with the dashboard at localhost:7777. A license key with no mode set by NR_AI_MODE or the config file makes the server fail to start.

environmentVariables.name: NR_AI_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Where telemetry goes: "cloud" (New Relic only), "both" (New Relic plus the local dashboard) or "local". Required when NEW_RELIC_LICENSE_KEY is set, unless the config file sets a mode. cloud turns off the local dashboard and local alerts.

environmentVariables.name: NEW_RELIC_ACCOUNT_ID
environmentVariables.description: New Relic account id. Required when NR_AI_MODE is cloud or both; also used for dashboard and alert deployment.
